evidence: REVISE: REQUIREMENTS.md requires every non-callable data value to survive print/read, yet the language produces Symbol('nil') for (type nil); print_value renders it as nil and read_one restores None.
REVISE: a 5000-digit decimal matching the documented integer grammar raises READ_INTEGER on both available Python versions, whose conversion ceiling is 4300 digits.
REVISE: multiplying two accepted 3000-digit integers succeeds, but print_value leaks host ValueError; the CLI exits 1 with a traceback instead of printing the result and exiting 0.

REVISE: both subprocess.run calls in the CLI test helpers capture output but specify neither a bounded timeout nor process-group isolation, so a faulty learner CLI can hang validation or leave descendants.

The reference passed 24/24 public and 34/34 sealed tests on Python 3.6.8 and 3.11.5 with TMPDIR directed to the writable review workspace; the independent differential and malformed-bytecode matrices also passed 55/55 and 24/24 cases.
Manifest labels are candid: status is GENERATED, labels are only GENERATED and PARTIAL, independent validation is REQUIRED, and productionized is false.
The CC0 catalog/NOASSERTION linked-resource distinction is explicit, but the generated material has no affirmative license grant.
limitations: The exact public-suite command initially failed one test because this review sandbox exposes no usable system temporary directory and CANDIDATE is immutable; TMPDIR=.. made all 24 tests pass without changing the candidate.
The upstream linked resource and source checkout were unavailable, so the no-copy statement and upstream license facts could not be independently verified by comparison.
No materialized student view or transfer receipt was supplied; recursive exclusion of all sealed directories is therefore inconclusive despite clear namespace documentation.
No randomized fuzzing, coverage-guided fuzzing, benchmark, profiler, coverage measurement, static type analysis, transfer verification, deployment, or production/security certification was performed.
